confidenceLegend.CONFIRMED: file number, channel folder and content all agree with the evidence map
confidenceLegend.PROBABLE: name/number/channel agree but content not fully verifiable here (media not played, or a detail the map relies on is absent)
confidenceLegend.CONFLICT: an asset exists but disagrees with the map (number, channel, content, type, date or identity)
